description: This file defines constants, data structures, and function prototypes related to handling pack mtimes in a version control system, likely Git. It provides interfaces for loading mtime data associated with pack files and retrieving mtime information for objects within those packs.

methods.name: load_pack_mtimes
methods.description: Loads the .mtimes file corresponding to a given packed_git object, returning zero on success.

methods.name: nth_packed_mtime
methods.description: Returns the mtime associated with the object at position 'pos' in the pack, used for determining object modification times.
